NBA DFS Picks for Friday, October 30 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Friday, October 30 · 8 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 30, 2:18 PM ET

Giannis Antetokounmpo (MIA) is the top-projected player on the Friday, October 30 DraftKings main slate at 58.9 DraftKings points for $10,500. Jayson Tatum (BOS, 52.7, $9,800) and Cade Cunningham (DET, 50.4, $9,600) are next.

Bobby Portis (MIA) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 5.83 projected points per $1,000 at $4,600.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 30, 2:18 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
